row.notes: Computes a state code for a driver in the contract hub: 2 if online (self+0x390) and lead player not participating co-op; 3 if the driver's active record (list *(self+0x350)+0x298, id at +0x50, active +0x2C) has status byte +0x12 in mask 0x6DFF; 5 if record +0x1C < driver overall rating; 6 if a range lookup of +0x18 in table self+0x318 equals +0x1C; else 4 when a count from vcall +0x100 exceeds roster size * float self+0x344, else 0. Better context needed: UI meaning of each code.
